caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a wide-brimmed bonnet, primarily colored in soft beige with grayish-blue tones on the interior brim. The bonnet is adorned with an arrangement of pink and white flowers with green leaves on the inner, outward-facing side of the brim. There are long, light beige or off-white ribbons with delicate trim hanging from the bonnet, tied in a bow beneath the brim and extending downward. In addition, on the lower right of the image, there are two simple, smaller outline sketches showing the bonnet viewed from above and from below, focusing on the bonnet's general shape and the position of the ribbons. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Wedding Bonnet
